verdict.rationale: Choosing where your data is stored is a fair question for a cloud-synced 2FA app like Authy, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing about region or residency selection. The backup feature describes encryption with a user password, not any choice of storage location, so it is an adjacent privacy control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
